thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: prod-canary alert for route /v1/infer (model_v12). 5xx rate 31% in last 5m, latency tail > 2s. Page sent to oncall. https://ops.monitor/prod-canary/360123

devon (oncall): acked. looking now. paging maya for infra help :rotating_light:

maya: joining — grabbing logs from canary nodes

oliver: I see GPU OOMs on node canary-3 and model shim retries. Rolling stats: connection resets + preemption events.

devon (oncall): can we flip the canary flag first to drain traffic? Don't want full rollback until we confirm impact.

sasha: product asks: any customer-facing errors yet? eva, can you surface top impacted tenants?

eva (support): getting ~40 tickets from two customers, EU region mostly. I'll open a banner and note degraded responses.

maya: trying quick kill-switch: 
```
# flip canary off
curl -s -X POST https://feature-flags.internal/flip \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"flag":"model_v12_canary","state":"off"}'
```

release-bot: FLAG CHANGE: model_v12_canary toggled to OFF by maya at 3601234678 :white_check_mark:

oliver: traffic is shifting back to model_v11 routing, but we're seeing increased latency on fallback nodes — possible cold start + kv-cache churn.

devon (oncall): what's the error volume after flip?
maya: 5xx down to ~6% from 31% in last minute. Good. Latency back to normal-ish but tail still a bit high.

sasha: product: mark as partial mitigation. Need rollback if instability persists. Customers are being notified by support.

devon (oncall): let's prepare manual rollback for canary group to revert the image. Plan: run rollback script for canary pool, then verify smoke tests. Rolling now if no objections.

maya: go ahead. I'll watch health and metrics.

devon (oncall): running rollback script:
```
./ops/rollback-canary.sh --pool canary --target image=model_v11 --timeout 600
```

release-bot: ROLLBACK JOB started by devon at 3601234775. job_id=rb-3601234775

oliver: nodes draining, restarting with model_v11. watching readiness probes.

maya: readiness green on 3/3 canary nodes. Health checks passing.

devon (oncall): running quick smoke against /v1/infer with sample prompt.
```
curl -s https://api.prod/v1/infer -d '{"prompt":"smoke test"}' | jq -r '.ok'
# result: true
```

devon (oncall): smoke OK. 5xx ~0.8% now. Latency p50/p95 back to baseline.

eva (support): updated banner: "Partial interruption to inference in EU region; service restored as of now. Follow-up ticket INC-360123 created."

sasha: documenting customer impact: ~120 failed requests over 7 minutes, 2 paying tenants had retries and UI errors. No data exposure.

maya: tagging logs and traces for postmortem: span ids X,Y,Z. Will collect core dumps from canary-3 for root cause.

devon (oncall): handing off to day shift: summary in INC-360123, action items: collect dumps, root cause analysis for model shim OOMs, add stronger circuit-breaker on canary rollout. Oncall off in 15m.

oliver: created follow-up infra task: INFRA-631 (increase canary memory headroom + better preemption handling).

sasha: product will coordinate customer outreach for the two impacted accounts.

devon (oncall): final check: metrics stable for 10m, closing urgent page. Will keep incident thread open for postmortem notes. thx all :tada:
